limitations: The ellipsoid is a chosen arithmetic region based on frozen local covariance, not a confidence or posterior region
Certificates apply only to the defined ellipsoid and closed held-out interval, not all parameters, all x or physical reality
Independent numerator and denominator relaxations are conservative and may produce very wide envelopes
Center-prediction containment and actual-residual coverage are arithmetic consistency checks, not probability coverage or external scientific validation
High-precision outward-rounded numerical certificates are not exact rational-algebra proofs
Unavailable folds have no finite prediction or residual bound and are never silently dropped
Chwirut1 shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2 and is not independent replication
